tool_calls.literal:
/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.stack_frames[0], (.value|tostring)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{s["'$1]+=$2; if($2>0)p[$1]+=$2; else n[$1]+=-$2} END{for(k in s) print s[k],p[k]+0,n[k]+0,k}'"' | sort -nr | head -30
jq -r '[.stack_frames[2], (.value|tostring)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{s["'$1]+=$2; if($2>0)p[$1]+=$2; else n[$1]+=-$2} END{for(k in s) print s[k],p[k]+0,n[k]+0,k}'"' | sort -nr | head -30
jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\") | [.labels.source_session[0],(.value|tostring)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{s["'$1]+=$2; if($2>0)p[$1]=1; else n[$1]=1} END{for(k in s){net+=s[k]; ps+=p[k]; ns+=n[k]; if(s[k]>0)npos++; else if(s[k]<0)nneg++} print "net",net,"candidate_sessions",ps,"base_sessions",ns,"netpos_sessions",npos,"netneg_sessions",nneg,"all_sessions",length(s)}'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.value, .stack_frames[0]]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$1>0){P+=$1;if($2=="result:repeated")PR+=$1}else{N+=-$1;if($2=="result:repeated")NR+=-$1}} END{printf "candidate_total=%d candidate_repeated=%d candidate_rate=%.4f base_total=%d base_repeated=%d base_rate=%.4f rate_ratio=%.2f net_excess=%d'"\\n\",P,PR,PR/P,N,NR,NR/N,(PR/P)/(NR/N),PR-N}'
jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\") | [.stack_frames[2],(.value|tostring)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{s["'$1]+=$2;p[$1]+=($2>0?$2:0);n[$1]+=($2<0?-$2:0)} END{for(k in s) print s[k],p[k]+0,n[k]+0,k}'"' | sort -nr | head -12
jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\") | [.stack_frames[1],(.value|tostring)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{s["'$1]+=$2;p[$1]+=($2>0?$2:0);n[$1]+=($2<0?-$2:0)} END{for(k in s) print s[k],p[k]+0,n[k]+0,k}'"' | sort -nr | head -12"
